report_name: Redditch Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP) 2025
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to model cycling trends, forecast potential cycling trips for work and school journeys under different uptake scenarios, and identify popular cycling routes to inform the development of the LCWIP cycling network.
other_tools_developed: Sustrans 2023 Paths for Everyone Cost calculator, Healthy Streets Assessment Toolkit, and a prioritisation matrix based on 11 quality criteria weighted at 70% with Value for Money (AMAT) weighted at 30%.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The 2023 public engagement exercise resulted in alterations to the emerging LCWIP network, including the addition of a new northwest corridor (10) and significant changes to corridors 1 and 3.
pct_usage_quote: The PCT is an assessment tool that helps understand cycling trends by using information from the 2011 census. It analyses how people travel to work and school, highlighting the most likely routes for cycling.
length_of_cycle_network_proposed: 10 primary cycling routes (approx. 45kms); 11 secondary and 12 link cycling routes (approx. 42kms)
total_cost_of_network: £43.76m (primary routes) + £27.32m (secondary and link routes) + £5.2m (walking and wheeling network)
